name: playwright-rpa
description: Local visual RPA studio: nested action blocks, Playwright runner, recorder, and editable JS.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @rpa/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c cyan,blue,green "npm run dev -w @rpa/shared" "npm run dev -w @rpa/server" "npm run dev -w @rpa/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rpa/shared && npm run build -w @rpa/server && npm run build -w @rpa/web
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w @rpa/shared && npm run smoke -w @rpa/server
